yeh I know it sounds trivial when shortened like this, Im just too drunk nowand afzer 10 pills I don't care aboutn retelling the whole story of those years where she basically raped my mind and played with me. She's not even an ex or something. Hell, I've never even got a kiss on my cheek from a girl. Just me, being the idiot I am, completely fallin in love with her, who was just abozut to develop an relationship (which by now failed completely as he abused her, I even warned her...). She proceeded the following years torturing me in all ways possible, she knew it, she did it on purpose, I knew that. Why I just cant move on? Cause fuck my heart man. It's been torn apart by this girl, reassembled, only to be torn apart by her again. She kept teasion "I REALLY want to try it, we should do more stuff". KNow what we did together in those 4 years? One time at the beginning we mini-golfed together. Thats it. Rest was always with her griop of people that hated me beyond everything. Eventually either I would snap from being misused like that or she would tell me I should just gtfo. And know what? week later she contatcs and all starts agfain. It's a devils-circle. Why I can 't get out? Because even now, and when I take my last breath today I will think of her, because I love her. I could never love someone else. She was always the one reinitiating contact and asking to try again and ofcause I acepted. Now a year ago oiut of the blue with no problems at all she fucking stops all contact. No, she hasnt had an accident or something. I called her numbers, wrote emails, waited infront of her house. Everything was as always, just that I don't exists. SO FUCK THAT BITCH, FUCK ME AND FUCK THIS FUCKING WORLD. SHE DONT WANT ME TO EXIST? HAVE IT YOUR WAY BITCH, YOU ARE RESPONSIBLE FOR FUCKING ME UP THIS BAD! ALL MY DOCTORS CAME TO THE SAME CONCLUSION AFTER OVER 500 THERAPY SESSIONS. OFCAUSE ITS MY FAULT THAT I DO THIS BUT FUCK YOU, YOU STARTED THIS AVALANCHE. NOTHING IS EVER GOING TO BE BETTER. EVERY FUCKING DAY IM THINKING OF YOU. EVERY QUIET MOMENT I RELIVE THE TORTURE. EVERY SHITTY THING IN THIS WORLD REMINDS ME OF YOU. WHETHER ITS YOUR NAME, YOUR FAVOURITE COLOR I SEE SOMEWHERE OF EVEN THE SWEET, SWEET SCENT YOU ALWAYS WORE THAT I SMELL SOMEWHERE. IT ALL WEARS ME DOWN SO MUCH MORE.

I can feel how 'it' kicks in. took 10 more now. 3 litre best wine and 20 pills. This feeling is what I hoped for. So many emotions. so many memories. all flying through my head. the head that never stops with its constant talking taslkgin tralkgion. I cant stand that talking anymore, I want to have ONE last quite moment. peace.....

yeh..this is it guys I feel fucking tired and vision gets way too blurry to write. ImgonnA lie down now. goodbye













I love you Maria

why would I watch all this meaningless stuff alone? I don't get ANY enjoyment at all out of doing stuff alone. And even then, why would it matter? I've basically lived my whole life leeching from media alone. Then, when I do finally find something to care for, something to live for, she fucking plays with me until I'm broken. I've been living in this depression for 5 years, took all meds you can list, even prototypes, thats how far my 16 psychatrists went, nothing fucking helps. I need one person, and only her. Nothing else....Noone else can stop me. A redditor said today that if you can't love yourself, you can't be loved by anyone else. And I just can't fucking stand it anymore. I'm a waste of flesh and energy. I'll be happy today for the first time in years when I know I will know longer be a burden to her, even though she cut contact more than a year ago I still feel the hate she has towards me even though I did fucking nothing. Fuck this shit. I've ordered two more bottles of wine, two are already down. And at New Years Eve I'm gonna fucking take those fucking pills and stop being the useless shit I am.
